Messages.Author: niko...@hotmail.com
Messages.Body:
Is the action to leave torpor considered a "rescuing a vampire from
torpor" action, or is it an action type in itself?

Will catacombs and humanity work on an action to leave torpor?

This equipment card represents a unique location and does not count as
equipment while in play. When attempting to rescue a vampire from
torpor, the vampire with this location gets +1 stealth and burns 1
less blood if successful.

Unique master. Put this card on a ready vampire you control. When
attempting to rescue a vampire from torpor, this vampire gets +1
stealth and burns 1 less blood if successful. This vampire cannot
commit diablerie.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
niko...@hotmail.com wrote:
> Is the action to leave torpor considered a "rescuing a vampire from
> torpor" action, or is it an action type in itself?

The latter. [6.5.2]

> Will catacombs and humanity work on an action to leave torpor?

No.
